ANIMAL FACTORY TACTICS / SCENERY PARCEL B

Lamps and fires.

Seven floor-standing fixtures baked out of the 3D branch's painted furniture library through this game's own camera, relit to match the painted catalogue, and registered on their tiles by a ground-contact shadow. Art and placement only: nothing here emits light yet. ← Game · Facility sprites · Ground cover

In the renderer

Drawn by environment-renderer.js, the function the game itself calls, on a grass yard beside a standing cow and the painted crate and barrel. Every fixture should stand on the middle of its own footprint; the overlay outlines the footprint and marks with a cross the point the renderer plants a sprite's bottom on.

Loading artwork…

The sprites

Original 1254 × 1254 transparent PNGs. The rules are the 3D branch's own: every fixture blocks its tile, only the bedside table gives cover, and none blocks sight. The flames are baked into the sprite and do not flicker yet; animating them needs app.js to sort per-prop flame pieces, and paint-order.js already has the depth rule for that. The wall torch and the gooseneck sconce are not here: they mount on a tile edge and wait on open question 5 of the plan. See docs/tactics/LIGHTING.md.
